title: Interop testing against other MIMI implementations
description: Survey 2026-11-02 of public MIMI implementations: Haven (havenmessenger/interop, Rust, Apache-2.0; protocol-06 JSON + TLS-PL wire lanes, content-09, room-policy; runnable mTLS hub mimi-hubd; DIVERGENCES.md; issues open, 'feedback welcome'); Phoenix R&D (phnx-im/mimi-content, active, used in production by the Air app; mimi-room-policy July 2026; mimi-protocol structs only, stale; no license file on any); nexun-foundation/mimi-rs (Apache-2.0, room-policy at -02, stalled since 2026-02). No public MIMI code found from Wire, Cisco or Matrix. Goal: test mimid against independent implementations and send what breaks upstream (their trackers or the WG).
notes: Survey 2026-11-13 (mimid-1wgh.46.8). GitHub/GitLab/datatracker/mimi list/127 wiki; Codeberg search 429 (not checked). CHANGES: Haven havenmessenger/interop HEAD 3e2631f (2026-11-13), past 07ce96f, protocol-07 both lanes, content-09 (content-10 'not done yet'), room-policy-04, mimi-hubd runnable; runneglobal/interop is a stale July 2026 copy of Haven's first release, not independent. Phoenix phnx-im/mimi-content moved to content-10 (9df1b6a, 2026-11-03; head 9690d8f, which Air pins); room-policy unchanged since 2026-07-16; mimi-protocol stale since 2025-01. CORRECTION: Phoenix repos are licensed AGPL-3.0-or-later (REUSE LICENSES/ dir + Cargo license field), not unlicensed. nexun-foundation/mimi-rs still no commits since 2026-02-05 (README claims room-policy -03, not -02), BUT Proton Meet (ProtonMeet/meet-common, meet-client, GPL-3.0) depends on it unpinned (mimi-content, mimi-protocol-mls, mimi-room-policy) with nexun's mls-rs fork (active 2026-11-12): a production consumer. NEW: Arkret (arkret-org, Apache-2.0, Rust): coland server has a 'MIMI Provider Facade' (ak.profile.mimi_interop.v1, experimental) pinned to protocol-06, content-08, room-policy-03, kohbrok-identifiers-01; routes /.well-known/mimi-protocol-directory, key-material, update, notify, consent, identifiers/query; very active. openconv (nisarsyed, MIT, Rust): own content-09 codec in a chat app. absolutejs/secure-messaging-federation-mimi (TS): revision-pin profile only, explicitly no wire. Still nothing public from Wire, Cisco, Matrix. MarkAtwood/mimid is now PUBLIC on GitHub (baseline said not). 127: no MIMI project on wiki.ietf.org/en/meeting/127/hackathon; mimid/Mark not listed; no MIMI WG session on the 127 agenda (MLS meets). Side meeting (Rohan, list 2026-10-24..11-06): yes-remote Mark, Jason Bolduc (Haven, 'interop will be ready for this hackathon'); maybe-remote Marvin W., Konrad Kohbrok (Phoenix); Rohan requested Tue 08:00-09:00 PT; sidemeetings.ietf.org needs login. No Implementation Status sections in any WG draft; datatracker lists no implementation resources.
